title: Wright Flyer
prompt: the 1903 Wright Flyer on its launch rail at Kitty Hawk: start the engine, the chain-driven twin propellers spin, warp the wings, slide down the rail and lift off for the 120 ft first flight; see-through shows the engine, chains, propellers, wing-warping cradle and elevator
author: vamsibatchuk

title: Enigma machine
prompt: an Enigma cipher machine in its wooden case: set the three rotors, plug a cable into the plugboard, press a key and watch the current run through the rotors and reflector to light a lamp letter while the rotors step; see-through shows the keyboard, plugboard, rotors, reflector and lampboard
author: vamsibatchuk

title: Steam locomotive
prompt: a red steam locomotive on a length of track: shovel coal into the firebox, build steam pressure, open the regulator and pull the whistle as puffs rise and the driving wheels turn; see-through shows the firebox, boiler tubes, steam dome, cylinders, pistons and connecting rods
author: vamsibatchuk

title: Microscope
prompt: a school light microscope: turn on the light, place a slide on the stage, turn the focus knob until the cells sharpen, rotate the nosepiece to change lenses, and explode it into parts; see-through shows the lamp, condenser, objective lenses, eyepiece and focus rack
author: OPS-PIvers

title: Video doorbell
prompt: a video doorbell by a front door with a chime and phone: press the button so the chime rings and the phone shows the picture, trigger motion outside, talk back through the speaker, and switch to night mode; see-through shows the camera, motion sensor, microphone, speaker, chip and Wi-Fi radio
author: cbrock84 (Lantern Learn)

title: Retro Pentium PC
prompt: a beige-and-yellow 1990s Pentium tower PC with a 4x CD-ROM and floppy drive: press power, hit Turbo so the clock display jumps, insert a floppy and a CD, and open the side panel; see-through shows the motherboard, CPU and heatsink, RAM, drive cables and power supply
author: vamsibatchuk

title: Smart thermostat
prompt: a wall smart thermostat wired to a furnace and air conditioner: turn it up, cool it down, set a night schedule, switch to away mode and turn Wi-Fi off; see-through shows the temperature sensor, chip, relays, Wi-Fi radio and the furnace switching on and off
author: cbrock84 (Lantern Learn)

title: TV remote
prompt: a TV remote pointed at a TV: press Power, press Volume up, show the invisible infrared flashes, and put clear glass or a wooden board in the way; see-through shows the buttons, rubber contacts, chip, battery and infrared LED
author: cbrock84 (Lantern Learn)

title: Optical mouse
prompt: an optical computer mouse on a desk: slide the mouse, compare the camera's pictures, click the button and lift the mouse off the desk; see-through shows the red LED, lens, tiny camera sensor, chip, click switch and scroll wheel
author: cbrock84 (Lantern Learn)

title: Smart speaker
prompt: a smart speaker on a shelf: say the wake word, ask a question that travels to a server and back, play music, and press the mute button; see-through shows the microphone ring, chip, Wi-Fi radio, speaker cone and light ring
author: cbrock84 (Lantern Learn)

title: Bluetooth headphones
prompt: a pair of over-ear Bluetooth headphones and a phone: charge them, turn them on, pair the phone, and play a song; see-through shows the battery, Bluetooth chip, antenna, amplifier and speaker drivers
author: OPS-PIvers

title: TB6612FNG motor driver
prompt: a TB6612FNG dual motor driver breakout with two motors: power the bench, then send forward, reverse, brake and coast commands at different PWM speeds; see-through labels the MOSFET H-bridges, PWM and direction pins and motor outputs
author: 0xMovez

title: A4988 stepper driver
prompt: an A4988 stepper driver on a breadboard driving a NEMA17 motor: set the current limit with the trimpot, choose full step or 1/16 microstep, then step the motor; see-through labels the chip, current-sense resistors, trimpot, microstep pins and coil outputs
author: 0xMovez

title: ESP32-S3 DevKit
prompt: an ESP32-S3 DevKit board and a phone: plug into UART, upload a sketch, connect to Wi-Fi and open its web page on the phone, then put it in deep sleep; see-through labels the two-core chip, antenna, USB-UART bridge, regulator, RGB LED and buttons
author: 0xMovez

title: HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor
prompt: an HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor facing an object: power it, move the object to 10, 25 and 50 cm, and watch the ping go out and the echo come back with the distance readout; see-through labels the transmitter, receiver, crystal and driver chips
author: 0xMovez

title: MPU-6050 IMU
prompt: an MPU-6050 IMU on a GY-521 breakout: power it, tilt it, watch the raw gyro drift and the accelerometer jitter, then switch on the complementary filter; see-through labels the sensor chip, I2C pins and 3.3 V regulator
author: 0xMovez

title: PCA9685 servo board
prompt: a PCA9685 16-channel servo board with servos plugged in: connect the two I2C wires, center a servo at 90 degrees, then run an arm wave across the channels; see-through labels the PWM chip, I2C bus, servo power input and the four banks of outputs
author: 0xMovez

title: LM2596 buck converter
prompt: an LM2596 buck converter module between a battery and a robot: connect the battery, turn the trimpot to set 5.0 V or 3.3 V, try for 12 V, then stall the motor and watch a brown-out; see-through labels the regulator chip, inductor, diode, capacitors and trimpot
author: 0xMovez

title: QTR-8RC line sensor
prompt: a QTR-8RC reflectance sensor bar over a black line: power it, move the line under sensor 2, center and sensor 7, then upload the P controller and watch the robot follow; see-through labels the eight IR emitter-detector pairs and the timing readouts
author: 0xMovez
